results.content: NOTES: Note 1: Skin testing is contraindicated in the following situations: • Patients who have certain skin conditions (e.g., dermatographism, urticaria, cutaneous mastocytosis, Enzyme inhibitors) or may impair skin test sensitivity (e.g., tricyclic antidepressants, antihistamines) • Patients who are at high risk to testing (e.g., poorly controlled asthma, clinical history of
